mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a single month, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals the end of the accommodative phase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recovery when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.
